scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,ANGULAR,REACT,VUE,NEXT -c green,blue,magenta,yellow,cyan "npm --prefix api-mock run api" "npm --prefix angular-admin start" "npm --prefix react-estudiante run dev" "npm --prefix vue-kiosko run dev" "npm --prefix next-publico run dev"
